# 993 hollow Ti64 intake valve, F0 LPBF concept

**Status: **prohibited pending engineering**. No part is released; see [SAFETY.md](../../SAFETY.md).**

Independent concept of a hollow Ti-6Al-4V intake valve with four internal ribs and an open axial bore for depowdering. Only the head diameter, stem diameter, product envelope, declared mass and part number are published; all functional geometry remains an F0 hypothesis.

Catalogue record: [`catalog/parts/993-eng-intake-valve-ti64-hollow-f0-0001.json`](../../catalog/parts/993-eng-intake-valve-ti64-hollow-f0-0001.json)

## Material and manufacturing

|---|---|
| preferred process | LPBF |

| standard | ASTM F2924 and a program-specific valve specification to be contracted |
| supplier requirements | traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and recycling, oriented coupons with tensile, HCF/LCF, impact, creep, oxidation, wear and alpha case at temperature, proof of depowdering of the 5 mm bore over about 100 mm and an internal cleanliness criterion, qualification of the end closure, its sealing and its retention, full CT, metallography, penetrant testing and metrology after all post-processing, full-scale valve tests on a hot rig, a motored cylinder head, then an engine before the vehicle |
| post-processing | vertical-axis orientation and support strategy to be qualified, documented depowdering of the cavity through the open axial bore, stress relief and heat treatment qualified for the machine and parameters, HIP to be decided on the defect population and representative fatigue, closure of the end by a process to be defined, then CT and proof test, machining and finishing of the stem, seat, groove, head and datums, coating, tip hardness, guide-seat matching and clearance balancing |
